# Jm Castillo — Mix & Mastering Engineer

> Jm Castillo is a multi-platinum mixing and mastering engineer and music producer based in Seville, Spain. He mixed and mastered "Mi Luz" by RVFV & Rels B (8x Platinum, 250M+ streams) and has worked with artists such as Rels B, RVFV, David Bisbal, Camilo, Duki, Anitta and Lola Indigo. He offers online mixing and mastering worldwide, in Spanish and English, specialising in Latin/urban music (reggaeton, trap, R&B, dembow, afrobeats) and pop.

Contact: info@jmcastillo.es · Instagram: @jmcastillodj

## Services
- [Mezcla y mastering online (ES)](https://jmcastillo.es/mezcla-y-mastering/): mezcla, mastering, mezcla + mastering, stem mastering, EP/álbum. Presupuesto cerrado sin compromiso.
- [Mix & mastering services online (EN)](https://jmcastillo.es/en/mix-and-mastering/): mixing, mastering, mix + master, stem mastering, EP/album. Fixed no-obligation quote.
